design.cluster: 113 parent groups; 970 controls and 30 probes per control not independent
design.near_far: one control per parent based on preoutcome raw distance, tie by original attempt
design.raw_bit_distance: sum of XOR bitcounts at 60 windows; range 0..240
design.same_orbit: canonical lexicographically minimal full physical microstate at scheduler phase0 on exact recurrent cycle
design.source: Exp140/142 on-cycle phase0 states and control outcomes; no new intervention
design.within_distance: different responses among multiple distinct controls at identical bit Hamming distance
